hints.title: Group Size Bounds
hints.text: All assigned groups must have size k or k + 1. The maximum possible value for k is the minimum frequency m among all unique values.

hints.title: Frequency Decomposition Check
hints.text: A frequency count f can be split into groups of size k and k + 1 if and only if f % k <= f // k.

hints.title: Descend on Size k
hints.text: Test k from m down to 1. The first k for which every value's frequency can be partitioned yields the minimum total number of groups.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: U: number of unique values in nums
complexity.notes: Testing group sizes from min frequency down to 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partition search per element is NP-hard, but frequency math reduces check to division.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(U) auxiliary memory for frequency table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use division/remainder condition (f % k <= f // k) to check partition feasibility.
